agents.name: row-height law
agents.result: Google lays a row at 0.75*round((max(trHeight,content)+rule)/0.75): trHeight is a quantised floor, not a length. 362 is unruled (r=0) so it does not ramp +0.75/row at all - refutes the carry-over's '21.75 pt of pure ramp'. One LO-invariant probe at DocxWriter:6468 proposed.
